name: markychecky
description: A live board of what every Claude Code session is doing: each session's task list in its own section of one markdown file, opened in Markydowny so you can watch your agents check things off.

file.title: Board file
file.description: The markdown file every session writes its section to. ~ is your home folder.

open.title: Open in Markydowny
open.description: Open the board in Markydowny, in the background, the first time a session writes to it (macOS, when Markydowny is installed).

idle_hours.title: Keep ended sessions (hours)
idle_hours.description: How long a session's section stays on the board after the session ends.
